meta.title: Our Job Poster
meta.textType: functional: a class poster about jobs, with daily routines

paragraphs: Teacher Kim's class makes a poster called "Jobs People Do." Each child draws a person at work. They use markers and pencils. Then the child writes two lines about the day of that job. Lily draws a mechanic. "A mechanic gets up early," writes Lily. She writes, "He fixes cars and machines at a garage." May draws an engineer. "An engineer builds a bridge," writes May, "and she works in an office."

"I am going to be a businessman," says Leo. Leo likes money. Leo draws a man with a big black bag. He writes, "A businessman goes to the bank every day." Mia loves animals, so she draws an animal doctor. Mia likes dogs best. "I am going to study at a university," says Mia. The doctor looks at an x-ray of a dog. Mia writes, "A doctor helps animals every day."

Two more children draw a pilot and an actor. One writes, "A pilot gets up at four o'clock, and she works at the airport." The airport is big and busy. The poster also has pictures of a factory and a hotel. "A factory has big machines," writes May. "A hotel has many rooms," writes Leo. The pictures show what each child likes.

Teacher Kim looks at the poster and smiles. "This is a very good poster," she says. The poster asks, "What job do you want?" Lily likes books and drawing. "I am going to make picture books," she says. "Are you going to make a book about jobs?" asks Mia. "Yes, I am," says Lily. The poster goes on the classroom wall. Everyone claps.
text.summary: Teacher Kim's class makes a poster about jobs. Each child draws a person at work and writes two lines about the day of that job.
